items.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
items.summary: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

items.title: Blur Disables Upgrades, Removing an ETH Rescue Route
items.summary: Developer Quit identified 545.6 ETH in 315 contracts lacking a direct withdrawal path.

items.title: Chainflip’s losses climb to $12 million after protocol discloses 122.9 BTC theft, offers hacker bounty
items.summary: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return the remainder of the $12 million in stolen BTC, ETH, and stablecoins by Monday.

items.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
items.summary: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful.
